description.en: Reads a temporary, map-scoped byte value previously set with CMND_SET_TEMP_MAP_BYTE_FLAG. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.
Index of the temporary map-scoped byte value to read.

example.code:
// Read back a stored map-local counter value
local count = CMND_GET_TEMP_MAP_BYTE_FLAG(0);
